prompt: A white porcelain teacup on a wooden terrace overlooking a quiet harbor at sunrise. Warm natural light, detailed ceramic glaze, coherent reflections, cinematic composition.
motion_prompt: Steam rises in delicate changing curls. Boats gently sway. Keep the cup shape and location consistent for the entire shot.
camera_prompt: One continuous slow dolly toward the teacup, stable horizon, no cuts.
continuity_prompt: Preserve the same cup, terrace, light direction and harbor geography throughout.
sound_intent: Native synchronized stereo sound: gentle waves, distant gulls, soft breeze. No speech and no music.
negative_prompt: watermarks, unwanted captions, abrupt transitions, flicker, object deformation
